title: Juice N Power Surge Mango Medley 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Soft, sweet juicy mango dominates this sublime ejuice from Juice N Power, with other soft tropical notes on the exhale. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks.
